patch_description: Building on the strongest prior candidate (RY → shared-pair CRZ ring → RX → single-shared CRZ skip, which reached score 0.87 with only 19 unique parameters per block and fast convergence in ~180 steps), this version keeps that proven efficient core intact and appends a final per-qubit RZ layer (8 unique parameters) right before read-out. This creates the classic rotate‑entangle‑rotate‑entangle‑rotate hardware-efficient pattern: the extra terminal phase rotation gives the read-out an additional independent degree of freedom on every qubit without re-introducing the heavy per-edge parameterization that hurt the most recent (mid-RY) variant (score 0.83, 212 params, slower convergence). Parameter sharing is preserved for entangling layers (2 shared params for the ring, 1 shared param for skip connections) to keep the effective parameter count and circuit depth low, aiming to improve validation accuracy and reduce the train/validation gap while remaining parameter-efficient and fast-converging.
